list_trackings.description: List the shipments tracked in your AfterShip account, optionally only those with certain statuses (such as Exception or Failed attempt) or updated recently. Each one comes with the customer's name and email, the order number, the status in plain words and a tracking link, ready for an email or a support ticket.

description: Connect your AfterShip account to detect couriers, create shipment trackings, and check delivery status.

aftership_shipment_status_changed_trigge.description: Runs once each time a shipment you track in AfterShip moves to a new status, or only to the statuses you choose, such as Exception or Failed attempt: the way to email a customer or open a ticket once per delivery problem. Shipments already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.
